title: Who Will be the Next Truck Giveaway Winner?

body_markdown:
Landstar is giving away a big rig to one of its nearly 10,000 independent owner-operators (business capacity owners or BCOs). The annual Deliver to Win Truck Giveaway powered by Comdata, will happen Wednesday, Sept. 12, during Landstar’s BCO Appreciation Days event in Rockford, Illinois.


As the final giveaway truck of the year, the metallic-gray 2019 Kenworth T680 is reserved for one lucky Landstar BCO.


The T680, touted by Kenworth as being the world’s most aerodynamic truck, is spec’d with a Cummins X15, 450 HP engine and a 13-speed Eaton Fuller transmission. Called “the driver’s truck,” the T680 is equipped with an enhanced fuel efficiency package with an “aggressive aerodynamic design,” to lessen a driver’s environmental impact and increase the overall driving experience. According to Kenworth, the 2019 model truck with a 76-inch high roof offers spacious, modern and ergonomic comfort.


During each contest period, BCOs earn entries by hauling safe and compliant loads. Additional entries are earned by BCOs who voluntarily participate in Landstar safety meetings, events and business classes, as well as monthly online contest entries through DeliverToWin.com. During the 2018 contest period (September 1, 2017 – July 31, 2018), BCOs earned 189,426 entries.


The Landstar Deliver to Win Truck Giveaway, powered by Comdata, will be held on the first night of the two-day event in Rockford, Illinois, Sept. 12 and 13. Landstar BCO Appreciation Day events are held throughout each year to thank Landstar BCOs for their service, dedication and commitment to safety.


Follow the excitement of the event and the giveaway on the[Landstar Owner-Operator (BCO) Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/LandstarOwnerOperators/) .
